en.recovery_error: Recovery could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
en.reset_success: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
en.reset_guidance: Use the 12-character code emailed to you. Your new password must contain at least 12 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.
en.password_mismatch: Passwords must match and meet the stated length.
en.recovery_unavailable: Recovery email is unavailable. Contact the platform operator.
en.recovery_limit: Too many requests. Wait before trying again.
